note: Slovenská sporiteľňa: the SPACE account costs 7 euros a month from 27 to 61, nothing to 26, and 3.50 from 62; the game charges it as two halves, both waived under 27 and the second from 62. Its Moja odmena programme, which can waive the fee for card spending and regular payments, isn't modelled. Read again 2026-11-03: the bank's answer page (aky-je-mesacny-poplatok-za-vedenie-uctu) no longer gives the figures, only that the SPACE account can be had without a fee through Moja odmena; they were read from its price list (Sadzobník, part A, published 24 April 2026, in force from 1 July 2026): 0.00 € a month from 6 to 14 and from 15 to 26, 7.00 € from 27 to 61 and 3.50 € from 62 (0.00 € with the Moja odmena discount); the price list published 26 October 2026, in force from 1 January 2027, gives the same.
